name: Role Of Parents
overview: Scripture emphasizes the vital role of parents in guiding and nurturing their children according to God's commands. Parents are called to lovingly discipline their children, as shown by the instruction that sparing the rod is harmful, while timely correction expresses love and imparts wisdom. They are also entrusted with training their children in the right way so that these teachings remain with them throughout life. This responsibility is rooted in the foundational relationship between parents and children established from the creation of the family unit.
